admission.justification: The public producer, file storage, lifecycle or native transport owners must preserve this same boundary across their distinct source locations.

applicability: Role-agent handover return addresses and ordinary returns after parent replacement.
conditions: A leaf return uses its master Manager role and canonical references.
exclusions: Developer chat text and native host chat display
Messages via removed earlier orchestration tools
Developer-question and authorization routing are not independently defined by the ordinary-return guarantee.

evidence: ReturnAddressTests incl. Manager-replacement reachability; checks-attempt4/pytest-focused.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: A return goes to the parent's role with its task references from the handover return address, never to an id read from an earlier message, surviving replacement.
